newsitem.title: USA: CILCORP Q1 margins hurt by warmer weather.
newsitem.headline: CILCORP Q1 margins hurt by warmer weather.

text.p: CILCORP Inc, reporting lower first-quarter earnings, said warmer than normal weather in the area served by Central Illinois Light resulted in a $0.16 per share decline in gas and electric operating margins compared to the first quarter of last year.

Heating degree days, a key indicator of gas and electric space heating requirements by residential and commercial customers, were more than eight percent lower in the 1997 first quarter than in the 1996 quarter and five percent lower than the normal number of first quarter heating degree days.
CILCORP reported quarterly earnings of $0.71 per share, down from $0.78 per share a year ago.
